text.title: Roadmap Design Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of Roadmap Design.

example.scenario: Solo SaaS, 3-quarter horizon, medium uncertainty, 2 audiences (internal team + customer). r6 picks Now/Next/Later. Internal source-of-truth: 2 items in Now (high confidence), 3 in Next (medium), 4 in Later (low), each linked to one of 3 outcomes (activate / retain / monetise), plus 3 explicit exclusions with reasons. External derivative: 3 themes only — 'faster signup', 'better admin', 'API' — no metric targets, no confidence labels, no owners. Cadence: monthly internal review, quarterly external publish.
example.trace: r6-format-by-uncertainty → r1-outcome-not-feature → r2-three-horizons → r3-confidence-labels → r10-not-doing-list → r7-one-source-many-views → r8-no-external-metric-targets → r9-publish-cadence → validated artefact
